title: Selena Gomez and Demi Lovato reunite for ‘Delena’ Rare Beauty campaign
summary: The childhood friends have tapped into the beauty nostalgia trend with Rare Beauty’s new ‘Still Making Each Other Blush’ campaign, inspired by the pair’s film Princess Protection Program and The Demi + Selena Show YouTube series
